long_biography.plain_text:
Curtis built his career in the self-storage and commercial-building products industry. He founded Doors & Building Components, developed it into a roll-up-door manufacturer and sold the business before establishing Janus International with 18 employees. At Janus he engineered a third-generation steel door using a maintenance-free dead-axle design, creating a product platform for national and international expansion.

Janus grew through new plants, joint ventures and acquisitions into a supplier of doors, hallway systems, relocatable units and facility automation. Curtis led the company as founder, president and chief executive, then retired from executive management and served briefly as co-chairman and director. His defining contribution remains the combination of product engineering and company building that helped turn a specialist door manufacturer into a global self-storage systems business.
